name: French A2.2
description: In this module, students gain further basic knowledge of French as a foreign language, enabling them to successfully deal with every-day situations. Listening and reading comprehension as well as speaking will be practiced with various listening exercises and texts (the world of work, new media, environmental protection, culture). The review and extension of grammar refers to communicative learning goals (emphasis: the future, gerunds, indirect speech, past perfect, the subjunctive). Students will learn strategies for successfully communicating orally and in writing with minimal language skills. Additionally, opportunities will be made available to more effectively learn French as a foreign language and thus to improve the student's ability to learn.
prerequisites: Sound knowledge of Level A2.1; placement test results A2.2.
